en.headline: Observatory keeps Red Fire Danger Warning in force
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory said the Red Fire Danger Warning remains in force, indicating extreme fire risk under the dry northeast monsoon.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory continues to maintain the Red Fire Danger Warning, which was issued at 6 a.m. on Friday. The warning indicates that the fire risk is extreme.

A dry northeast monsoon is affecting the territory, bringing fine, hot and very dry conditions. The Observatory said the maximum temperature on Friday reached 32.3 degrees Celsius at its headquarters, the highest ever recorded for the solar term Frost.

The Strong Monsoon Signal that was in force earlier on Friday was cancelled at 12:45 p.m. Under the continuing dry conditions, the fire danger warning remains active. Residents are reminded to take extra care with open flames and flammable materials.

zh.headline: 天文台維持紅色火災危險警告
zh.dek: 香港天文台表示，紅色火災危險警告仍然生效，顯示在乾燥東北季候風影響下火災危險性極高。
body: 香港天文台繼續維持周五上午6時發出的紅色火災危險警告。警告表示火災危險性極高。
乾燥的東北季候風正影響本港，天氣天晴、炎熱及非常乾燥。天文台表示，周五總部錄得最高氣溫32.3度，是有紀錄以來最熱的霜降。
周五較早前生效的強烈季候風信號已於下午12時45分取消。在持續乾燥天氣下，火災危險警告仍然有效。市民應小心使用明火及易燃物品。
